title: A Distributional Optimisation Perspective on Combining Models in Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.24328v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Combining predictions from different models can improve performance at machine learning tasks, but the training of the individual models and the rule used to combine them are typically chosen separately, and by ad hoc means. Recent advances in distributional optimisation (i.e. where the optimisation occurs over the set of probability distributions) offer an opportunity for principled joint training, viewing the collection of models as a discrete distribution whose support points are to be optimised, but the potential of these methods is not well-understood. translated_title: 深度学习中模型组合的分布优化视角
translated_abstract: 组合不同模型的预测可以提升机器学习任务的性能，但单个模型的训练以及用于组合它们的规则通常是分开选择的，且往往采用临时的方法。分布优化（即优化过程在概率分布集合上进行）的最新进展为有原则的联合训练提供了机会——将模型集合视为一个离散分布，其支撑点有待优化——但这些方法的潜力尚未得到充分理解。在本文中，我们（1）将两种标准的组合策略——集成和低秩适配器平均——表述为熵正则化的分布优化问题，并观察到所得目标函数在集成情形下是凸的，而在适配器平均情形下不是凸的，因此均场朗之万动力学的现有收敛保证仅适用于前者；（2）评估现有的……
tldr: 该论文将深度学习中的模型组合（集成与低秩适配器平均）统一表述为熵正则化的分布优化问题，并揭示集成情形下目标函数为凸、可借用均场朗之万动力学的收敛保证，而适配器平均情形则不具凸性。
en_tdlr: This paper casts model combination in deep learning (ensembles and low-rank adapter averaging) as entropy-regularised distributional optimisation, showing the resulting objective is convex for ensembles—enabling convergence guarantees from mean-field Langevin dynamics—but not for adapter averaging.
